decision_rule.FREE_RUNNING_SEQUENCE_FAILURE: If Treatment has strong TRAIN teacher-forced ranking but poor native-Greedy exactness with early divergence or output-construction error, support a sequence-level or output-construction failure.
decision_rule.STRUCTURAL_GENERALIZATION_FAILURE: If Treatment has strong TRAIN ranking and exactness but weak structural-OOD ranking and exactness, support a representation or structural-generalization failure.
decision_rule.TRAIN_RANKING_FAILURE: If Treatment has poorer Connected Component Count TRAIN teacher-forced ranking, margin, or NLL than Control in the same direction as its existing exact-fit deficit, support insufficient effective fitting or optimization under the fixed diverse budget.
decision_rule.invalid: Any checkpoint, cohort, target-token, prompt, decoder, completeness, batch1 sensitivity, or paired-support failure is INVALID_NOT_INTERPRETABLE and selects no training mechanism.

execution_shape_and_budget.formula: 3 checkpoints * (24 TRAIN_FIT Connected Component Count + 48 structural OOD)
execution_shape_and_budget.no_update_gpu_estimate: Bounded at 3,600 seconds planned and 10,800 seconds hard cap; this is conservative because the proposed diagnostic has no optimizer, backward, or parameter updates but adds teacher-forced forwards.
execution_shape_and_budget.reference: RUN_002 raw generation froze 392 evaluations in 779.9362430069596 seconds, with two 96-step training arms also present.

free_running.decoder: the same NATIVE_GREEDY decoder and max_new_tokens=192
free_running.first_divergence: first index at which generated token differs from the correct target token; if every shared token agrees and lengths differ, use shared-prefix length; otherwise null
free_running.frozen_native_greedy_correlation: join exactly by checkpoint, cohort, and record ID to the existing RUN_002 raw prediction hashes and score outcome where that existing raw row exists; retain new raw token hashes for V7 TRAIN rows because no V7 TRAIN row exists in RUN_002

semantic_error_taxonomy.method: Use an independent deterministic semantic comparator after raw predictions are frozen. Record multi-label semantic axes plus exactly one exclusive primary code. PARSER_FAILURE is primary if unparsable; DIMENSIONS is primary for shape mismatch; otherwise choose the first present axis in CONNECTED_COMPONENT_COUNT, SELECTED_OBJECT_IDENTITY, GEOMETRY, COLOR, OUTPUT_CONSTRUCTION order. OUTPUT_CONSTRUCTION applies only when semantic selected-object/count/geometry/color axes agree but canonical output assembly differs.

teacher_forced.margin: logit(correct token) minus max logit(any incorrect token) at the same position
teacher_forced.sequence_normalized_NLL: mean over records of [sum(-log p(correct token)) / correct-token-count]
teacher_forced.token_weighted_NLL: sum(-log p(correct token)) / all supervised correct tokens in the family
teacher_forced.unit: each correct target token at its fixed prefix under one causal forward

scope: One no-optimizer-update diagnostic. It measures fixed V7, Control, and Treatment only; it does not retry RUN_002 or introduce a training variant.
